title: The Sweet Garden
author: Sebastian Crane
blurb: Kestrel Okafor, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
